result:
I’d remove the default habit of treating other humans as strangers who don’t really exist.

Not a rule. Not a law. Just the felt sense: before I dismiss, mock, fear, or destroy someone, I momentarily understand that they are alive in a body, shaped by wounds and loves I can’t fully see, and that my judgment of them costs something real.

If people made each other feel real more consistently, most of the world’s cruelty would lose its power.
